categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Yangfan New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the fine chemicals sector, focusing on the research, production, and sales of sulfur-containing organic intermediates and photoinitiators. The company’s main product lines include photoinitiators used in radiation curing industries and intermediates such as mercapto compounds and phosphorus-containing flame retardants, serving pharmaceutical, pesticide, dye, and electronic chemical markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced chemical synthesis technologies centered on sulfur and phosphorus chemistry, with mature and continuously improved production processes for photoinitiators and intermediates. It employs specialized manufacturing techniques for mercapto compounds and has developed proprietary technologies for phosphorus-based materials, including recycling and high-efficiency synthesis. The firm also integrates R&D with industrial-scale pilot and mass production capabilities, supported by a provincial enterprise research institute and a postdoctoral research station.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span multiple industries including pharmaceuticals, agriculture (pesticides), dyes, electronics (PCB, semiconductors, displays), coatings, inks, adhesives, and emerging fields like 3D printing. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with products applied in radiation curing materials for UV coatings, inks, adhesives, and optical components, as well as intermediates for drug and pesticide manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Zhejiang (Hangzhou Bay, Shangyu), Jiangxi (Pengze), and Inner Mongolia (Alxa). It serves domestic markets extensively and exports products internationally, leveraging its global supply chain and participating in international exhibitions to expand overseas presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Yangfan New Materials occupies an upstream to midstream position in the chemical supply chain, producing key raw materials and intermediates such as photoinitiators and mercapto compounds that are essential inputs for downstream manufacturers of coatings, inks, adhesives, pharmaceuticals, and pesticides. The company controls the full production process from raw materials to finished chemical intermediates and specialty chemicals.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic R&D priorities include developing new photoinitiators compatible with LED UV light sources, low-VOC and environmentally friendly UV curing materials, and high-performance phosphorus-based flame retardants. It focuses on green chemistry innovations, phosphorus resource recycling, and expanding applications in high-tech fields such as 5G/6G communications, clean energy, and advanced optical materials. Collaboration with top universities and recruitment of national and international experts underpin its innovation efforts.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products including photoinitiators, mercapto intermediates, and phosphorus-containing flame retardants. The company employs a combination of direct sales to end customers, distributor sales, and customized contract manufacturing services. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods, with pricing strategies adapted to market competition and customer requirements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic and global supplier in the photoinitiator and mercapto compound markets, competing with firms such as IGM, Jiuri New Materials, Qiangli New Materials, and Gurun Technology. It maintains a strong market position through its full industry chain integration, technological innovation, and scale advantages, despite intensified competition and cyclical market pressures.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 731 million, a 5.8% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 46 million, showing a significant reduction in losses compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets were about RMB 1.36 billion with equity of RMB 681 million. It has experienced fluctuating profitability due to market cycles but is actively improving operational efficiency and expanding capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Yangfan New Materials emphasizes its comprehensive industry chain integration, proprietary technologies in sulfur and phosphorus chemistry, and strong R&D capabilities as key differentiators. Its products offer high quality, environmental compliance (low VOC, green chemistry), and tailored solutions for diverse downstream applications. The company’s strategic focus on innovation and sustainable development, combined with robust safety and environmental management, positions it as a reliable partner in specialty chemicals.
